item.description: ​ 📅 WHEN DOES SPOTIFY WRAPPED 2026 DROP? 🎁 ​We are officially in the final stretch! While Spotify never confirms the exact launch date in advance, the pattern is crystal clear. 🔍 ​For the past 5 years, Wrapped has always dropped on a Wednesday between late November and early December: • 2023: Nov 29 • 2024: Dec 4 • 2025: Dec 3 ​Following that exact trend, all eyes for 2026 Wrapped are on Wednesday, December 2 ! 🗓️ ✨ ​ 📲 Quick prep tip: Make sure your Spotify app is updated to the latest version so the Wrapped banner pops up on your Home screen the second it goes live. 🚀 💚
